# Play — Mind the Gap

- SudokuPad: [Mind the Gap on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Mind the Gap on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
The indexing rule is exported as f-puzzles **column indexer** cells (every cell of columns 1, 5 and 9). Rangsk's solver reads that entry and
finds the same unique solution, which confirms the export means the 1-5-9 rule. Thermometers are native. The whispers are drawn as
green cosmetic lines, the same way earlier gallery puzzles export them, so the apps won't enforce them. I have not opened the links in a
browser, so I can't say how SudokuPad draws the indexer cells. If the shaded columns don't show, use `grid.svg` in this folder as the
reference picture.

Lines: whispers r1c1–r3c1, r4c1–r6c1, r1c4–r3c4, r4c5–r6c5, r7c5–r9c5, r4c8–r6c8, r1c9–r3c9, r7c9–r9c9; thermometers (bulb first)
r2c6–r3c6–r4c6 and r7c4–r7c5–r7c6.

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, solution).
